name: Kristoffer
bio: I was formerly among the youngest people ever. Now, I am {age} years old.
I'm from Norway, thus I love mountains, skiing and Jon Fosse.
I run, write and do projects. Here, I will only do the latter two.

projects.title: Dalai
projects.desc: Company started with my friend Simen. I sat as the CEO working with the great Mattis Holt as chairman. Learned lots, 30 customers, six-figured revenue.

projects.title: Askask
projects.desc: Bet largely on embedded AI agents for e-commerce. Got two pilot customers, downturn for norwegian e-commerce and failed spectacularly.

projects.title: Plugga
projects.desc: Exam and study planner/tracker with a exam set database for rating, discussing and viewing exams including grade distributions. Of course skills for agentic systems to write and pull information and integrated with Google and Apple calendar.

projects.title: OpenClaw Laif
projects.desc: Experimenting with a OpenClaw-based agentic system to properly coach me in sports and in general l(a)if (haha). Integrated skills for strava, plugga, and many more, in addition to building a custom gbrains-setup.

projects.title: Mosaic (not the browser)
projects.desc: Made a mosaic generator from scratch in Java and a front-end with quite ugly JavaFX-elements. My most ambitious non-AI-related project yet, very fun but slow. Still managed to get it done in under 16 hrs.

projects.title: make3d
projects.desc: Currently building a fast and lightweight tool for generating simple to moderatly complex 3d renderings from a 2d photos. Difficult and fun.

projects.title: Vibedoc.ai
projects.desc: Made a code-docs generator for the advent of vibe coding. Mostly a sick domain name, hmu if you want to buy it.

experience.title: Visiting Investment Analyst
experience.desc: Working part time with B2B SaaS at the Nordic software investor.

experience.title: Co-founder & CEO
experience.desc: Began doing custom reasoning LLM workflows for local SMBs, such as Hunderfossen, Kongeparken and Birken. Eventually turned to AI consulting projects for larger companies such as Standard and Sintef.

experience.title: Financial Journalist
experience.desc: Wrote for the Norwegian financial daily. Highest-converting intern.

experience.title: Analyst
experience.desc: Analysing and investing in Norwegian equities.

experience.title: International Athlete
experience.desc: 5 times Norwegian champion, youth European champion, competed in youth Olympics. National team athlete in Ski Mountaineering and Orienteering.

experience.title: Coach
experience.desc: Planned and lead training camps and weekly sessions for childeren ages 4 to 14 in several sports such as football, basket, athletics and orienteering.
